$comment: P31 (2026-08-24) — GNU `__builtin_choose_expr` + `__builtin_types_compatible_p`, the pre-C11 `_Generic`, in ONE example because neither half is much use alone: one answers a question about types and the other acts on the answer, and the idiom SHAPE 5 spells out is the reason both exist. ✔MEASURED through the shipped CLI at HEAD `60198126`: `error[S0001] __builtin_choose_expr` and `error[P0002] expected 'ParenClose' — got 'int'` — DSS was reading each as an ordinary CALL, which neither can be (one takes two TYPE-NAMES, the other DISCARDS an operand unevaluated). ✔MEASURED that gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3 and clang 19.1.1 compile this exact file and RUN it to 42. ★★ THE DISCRIMINATING SHAPES: SHAPE 1 initializes an `int` from `__builtin_choose_expr(1, 42, "not an int")`, so the line COMPILES only if the unchosen arm is dropped before it is type-checked as a value — an implementation that lowered both arms and selected at run time fails here rather than answering wrongly, which is the strongest possible statement of the discard. SHAPE 3's `(int, long)` line is a CROSS-DATA-MODEL discriminator and the reason this example declares both a pe64 and an elf64 target: on LLP64 `long` and `int` share a REPRESENTATION, so a compatibility test written as a width comparison answers 1 on Windows and 0 on Linux from one source with no diagnostic anywhere — the correct answer is 0 on both, because C compatibility is TYPE IDENTITY, which is exactly what [[D-LANG-TYPE-IDENTITY-VOCABULARY]] made the interned identity carry. SHAPE 6 puts `1/0` in the DISCARDED arm of a constant expression: if the const-eval engine visited both arms it would trip its own divide-by-zero wall and refuse the array dimension, so folding to 4 is possible only if the discarded arm is never visited at all. SHAPE 4 pins the RESULT TYPE rather than the value — the node must take the WINNER's type and not the controlling expression's or the first arm's — asked through `_Generic`, the one construct in the language that can ask. ★ THE `release` ARM: every check is an explicit early return, and `dss_seed` is `volatile`, so the exit code stays a FUNCTION of the measured answers.
